**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Dictation
- **Fn dictation is on by default.** If your 🌐 key is set to "Do Nothing" in macOS (System Settings → Keyboard → "Press 🌐 key to"), holding Fn now dictates out of the box, and the toggle in Settings and onboarding starts switched on. If you never changed that toggle, it turns on with this update. If macOS still uses the 🌐 key for something else, Settings tells you how to free it. You can switch it off anytime in Settings → General → Keyboard Shortcuts.

## Settings
- **An emptied prompt field stays empty.** Clearing a system prompt in Settings no longer brings the default text back after a moment, and trailing spaces or line breaks are no longer trimmed while you type. An empty field still means the default prompt is used.
- **Clearer hints.** The Dictate tab now says that offline models (Whisper, Parakeet) ignore the system prompt, and the Glossary explains its limit for long terms.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.69...v8.70
